heading: Workflow Builder
lead: Define the approval chain and final action for each request type.
help: Each request type has an approval chain, and each step is assigned to a role. Requests go through the steps sequentially, and after final approval, the final action is executed.
snapshotNotice: Changes to steps, form, and final action only affect requests submitted for the first time from now on. Ongoing and referred requests retain the definition registered at the time of submission.
active: Active (displayed in the student's request list)
noSteps: No steps; the request is completed immediately.
title: Title
draftNotice: You have unsaved changes. The draft of any request is preserved while you are on this page; save modified sections before leaving or reloading.

form.heading: Form fields
form.help: Define fields in the display order. Each section is saved separately. Changing the form does not affect previously submitted requests.
form.unsupported: This legacy definition has a structure not supported by the editor. The form has been preserved; editing other sections remains possible.
form.keyHelp: Unique key: letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens; change previous keys only for intentional form contract changes.
form.label: Field label
form.sectionHelp: This field is selected from the student's registered courses and its key is sectionId; add it only once per form.
form.optionsHelp: Each option is saved with this exact text. Duplicate or empty options are not allowed.
form.sectionPreview: Student's registered courses will be displayed when submitting the request.

rolesError: Failed to retrieve university roles; the chain draft has been preserved.

condition.heading: Step execution condition
condition.noFields: Please define at least one form field first.
condition.help: The condition only checks data from this specific form. Form values are not saved in the history.
